verdict.rationale: Activepieces publishes its source in a public GitHub repository that describes itself as "An open source replacement for Zapier", and its llms.txt calls it open-source. A community member independently notes the MIT license. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the exact license terms (MIT is attested only by the community), and any detail on whether some editions or features sit outside the open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
